name: lumon
description: Refine macrodata while Claude works. Open Lumon when you want to play and see when Claude is done or needs you. Automatic opening is opt-in.

delay.title: Open Lumon after
delay.description: Seconds Claude must keep working on a prompt before Lumon opens on its own. off opens it only with /lumon:play.

company.title: Computer refiners
company.description: How many computer refiners sit at the board with you. c in the game adds or sends them home.

mode.title: When Lumon opens
mode.description: play takes a desk; watch gets up and watches computer refiners work the file; screensaver shows the bouncing mark, and any key starts a game. w in the game switches between playing and watching.
